title: Ink
look: A heavy black line around every shape, flat paper colours, one accent.

doc.essence: A sticker-clean cartoon on paper: one heavy, even black line around every silhouette, flat colours inside, one accent.
doc.notIt: Not a sketch (the line never wobbles) and not a comic (no shading, no halftone).
doc.shapes: The outline is its own pass under the fills, so touching parts fuse with no seam. ~5.5 px at Secret Letter's scale; anatomies scale it.
doc.colour: Flat fills straight from the palette on paper (#FAF8F4). Body colour, one accent, ink.
doc.eyes: Solid ink, no shine; cheeks only when blushing.
pitfalls: Thin limbs drawn as strokes need their outline too: the rig draws a wider stroke underneath.
